long_biography.plain_text:
Jones co-founded Colour Themes with Philip Rebeiz, building an advisory focused on modern and contemporary art, collection strategy and institutional projects. Their associated company, Colour One, operates from London's Cork Street. Companies House records both men as significant controllers, with rights over shares, votes and director appointments.

His entrepreneurial interests also reached sustainable transport through Lunaz, a British business that converted classic and commercial vehicles to electric power. Jones was a founding investor alongside Navid Mirtorabi, and the venture attracted outside backing that included David Beckham. The group company entered administration in 2024 and moved into creditors' voluntary liquidation the following year.
